note: A create without `name` — a list nobody can tell apart from another is not worth creating.
An update that changes nothing — `listId` alone names a list and no change.
Colour given and removed together — dependentSchemas makes `removeColour` exclude `colour`.
`removeColour` on a create — there is no colour to remove; a create without `colour` has none.
Uppercase hex colour — one way to write each colour, lowercase.
A name with a line break — one line, so a list name cannot render as a forged second line in a picker.
Setting membership here — additionalProperties: false catches `contactIds`. A contact's lists are set on the contact with persona/contact/put 1.1, so membership has one writer.
Response without `changed` — a client could not tell an applied rename from a no-op.
Response carrying the pre-1.1 `created` flag — renamed `wasCreated`, since `created` is reserved for a timestamp; additionalProperties: false rejects the old name and `wasCreated` is required.
